Being a weekend when I had to get admitted and Dr. being out of town at the time of my admission, he remained constantly in touch with the hospital staff all through the night and closely monitored my situation. His dedication and commitment truly stood out. He made sure to be present at the hospital in the morning for the delivery, which meant a lot to us.

The hospital staff were also very supportive, attentive, and helpful throughout. The hygiene standards were excellent, and it was comforting to know that assistance was available 24×7.

What made the experience even more special was the thoughtful celebration after my baby’s birth—Dr. Parikh arranged a small cake-cutting and even gave gifts for my little one, which is something truly rare and heartwarming.

Additionally, Dr's wife personally came to meet me and my baby and gave a very informative and helpful talk on breastfeeding, which was completely unexpected and deeply appreciated.

My entire family and I are extremely grateful for the care, compassion, and professionalism shown by Dr. Parikh and the entire team.
Highly highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: PRATIK RAHATE
featured_reviews.review_text:
We approached Dr. Nitul Parikh with a lot of hopes after having a difficult history, and we are blessed with our baby boy in September 2025 – exactly as he had confidently told us after understanding our case in October 2024: “Next Diwali, you will celebrate with your baby.” His words gave us immense peace and confidence, and they came true.

For me, Dr. Nitul Parikh is like an image of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj – strict when it comes to following medical discipline and equally polite, caring, and nurturing with his patients.

He is like a elder brother to my wife, and I truly respect him and his entire “Vanar Sena” – the nurses, sisters, mavshi, and even the cleaners – who serve with dedication and warmth.

One thing that really stood out was that Dr. Nitul was always available on WhatsApp and calls during emergencies. This was something we lacked in our earlier experiences, and it made my wife feel even more secure and comfortable throughout her pregnancy journey.

We sincerely followed his guidance, and because of that, my wife had a smooth and swift delivery. Even if a family has no relatives around during pregnancy, Dr. Parikh’s own family (his wife and mother) makes sure to visit and support, creating a very homely and comforting environment. After our delivery, both his mother and wife blessed us with their kind words and presence, which was truly priceless.
We stayed in the deluxe room, which was very homely and well taken care of. At any hour, even midnight, the nurses and mavshi responded promptly with a smile, saying “Yes beta, kay zhala?” – such warmth is rare to find in hospitals.

For me, this hospital is not just a maternity and gynaec healthcare center – it is truly a temple, where every member of the team does their duty like a prayer. We are forever grateful to Dr. Nitul Parikh, Parikh family and his wonderful team for turning our hope into happiness. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: jovita pinto
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot thank Dr. Nitul and his entire team enough for the incredible support throughout my pregnancy and delivery journey. From the very beginning, Dr. Nitul patiently helped us understand every step of the process, clearly explained medications, and answered all our queries—no matter the time. That level of accessibility and reassurance made a huge difference and gave us immense confidence.

The maternity clinic and hospital are extremely well-lit, hygienic, and maintained impeccably at all times. I had a normal delivery, and what truly stood out was the team’s responsiveness—even in the middle of the night, they were prompt, calm, and supportive.

I had booked a deluxe room, and honestly, it didn’t feel like I was in a hospital at all. It was comfortable, well-equipped, and had all the requisites needed for both me and my baby. Post-delivery, the staff regularly checked on my health as well as my baby’s, ensuring we were doing well at every stage.

What touched me deeply was that Dr. Nitul’s mother and wife personally visited me post-delivery, spoke to me about the importance of breastfeeding, and genuinely took feedback on my experience. That personal warmth meant so much.

What made the experience even more special was the thoughtful gesture before discharge—the staff cut a cake for us and gifted us a baby kit, which was such a warm and unexpected surprise. It truly made us feel valued and celebrated during a very special moment of our lives.

Overall, this was not just medical care, but a beautiful, well-managed, and compassionate experience. I would highly recommend Dr. Nitul and his team to any expecting parents looking for expertise, empathy, and exceptional care.
